text: This solution, National Volcanic Hazard and Risk Model (NVHRM) addresses natural catastrophe through public private partnerships in New Zealand between Earthquake Commission (EQC), GNS Science, GeoNet, New Zealand emergency management authorities, Accident Compensation Corporation (ACC), Massey University, University of Otago, Victoria University of Wellington, University of Auckland, University of Canterbury, and Private insurers and re/insurers. The program was implemented in 2016 and focuses on collaboration and regulation.
